chunks: Fadala from al-'Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both) said:
I asked him about a man who forgot to pray the two rak'ahs, he said: 'He prays on his behalf.'

key_terms.يُصَلَّى عَنْهُ: he prays on his behalf / it is prayed for him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a person who forgets to pray two rak'ahs?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the mechanism for compensating for missed rak'ahs due to forgetfulness, affirming that the individual must perform the missing units themselves rather than having them performed by another. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on personal accountability in worship, distinguishing between voluntary compensation and obligatory make-up prayers. The context of Chapter 25 further links this to broader rules of error and condition violation during Hajj and Salah.
